description: Managers: npm (package.json and bun.lock), the digest-pinned bun image in the Dockerfile, GitHub Actions, and the `# renovate:` comments in the workflows. bunfig.toml enforces the 14-day wait on installs, so lock-file refreshes are on.

customManagers.description: Version pins Renovate's own managers can't see: the bun version the workflows set up (BUN_VERSION). Each carries a `# renovate:` comment naming its source.

packageRules.description: One PR for the non-major long tail; the groups below take their own packages out of it.
bun is pinned as the Dockerfile image and as CI's BUN_VERSION, and test/unit/build-pins.test.ts requires them equal, so they move in one PR.
The AI SDK core and its providers release in lockstep against a shared model spec.
No wait for the packages bunfig.toml exempts (minimumReleaseAgeExcludes), so a dependency reaches this repo on the same terms whether a bot or a person adds it.
